result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"competitive_share_entrants#0 已進 threats，CoreWeave 單一承租與 second-source 風險由 moat、single_thing 與 triggers 接住，沒有漏接的負向 finding。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.verdict_values.industry.sd_verdict_source","reason":"供需 durability 軸在 bundle 子集中沒有負向 finding；判斷自己寫了供給偏結構、需求在融資收緊時可逆，並接進 bear 與 premortem。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.triggers","reason":"關稅（reg_tariff_export#0）、LUNA 訴訟與和解（regulatory_antitrust#0、major_events#0/#1）、ATM（major_events#3）、替代技術（substitute_technology#0/#1）都已進 R3／R5／triggers／blind_spots。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"market_wrong_reason_given=false 加 wait_for_price=true，裁決落觀望是規則結果，不算矛盾；等待條件（Helios II 與投資等級承租方簽約、CoreWeave 付租正常）具體可驗。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.verdict_values.industry.bargaining","reason":"customer_second_source 與 customer_concentration_credit 兩軸標 not_applicable 且無查詢記錄，但 Helios I 全租給 CoreWeave，這兩軸其實相關；判斷已用 10-Q 與法說會內容補上承租方集中與信用的影響，缺口不影響結論。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.scenario_inputs.basis.bear","reason":"算術可複算：Base 19.5、Bull 47.4、Bear 4.2 與 EV +35.2%、IRR 5.2% 都對得上，Bull/Base 營收路徑與前兩年有實質價差，ROIIC 有算式，endo_ceiling 為 null 且說明了原因；但 Bear 明說不含 CoreWeave 違約，single_thing 又給該事件約 10%、股權可能歸零，樹內沒有這條尾端，EV 偏樂觀，不過裁決為觀望、方向不變，故只給 🟡。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.fact_refs","reason":"所引營運指標（資料中心調整後毛利 7,900 萬、133MW、放款 18 億、SBC 1,606 萬、現金 49 億）皆為 Q3 2026，與 latest_quarter_kpis 的 as_of 一致；FY1 共識 −86% 已說明是虧損縮小，沒有被當唯一依據。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"前份有值且變動的欄位（signal B→C、val 🟠→🟡、ma、price_at_dd）都對應到帶 cause 的條目，signal 歸因為新證據、val 歸因為價格變動且說明了同期新證據；其餘前份為 null 的欄位不計，QC-49 不適用。"}]
